fields.title: 📖 Whoever sins and repents finds Allah forgiving
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Whoever does evil or wrongs himself and then asks Allah for forgiveness will find Allah All-Forgiving and Merciful.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This Āyah guards against despair and against Ghulūw: sin is dangerous, but the door of Tawbah remains open.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nisāʾ 4:110.
